thread:
Taylor: quick postmortem follow-up 61; we need owners and short timelines for: quiet-hours suppressions, sensible threshold tweaks, dedupe windows for flapping alerts, and a verification checklist. Keep changes conservative.

Ivy: I'll own edge-proxy alerts (edge-timeout-*, edge-502-*). Proposal: loosen short-window threshold a bit and add 3m burst suppression for deploy windows. Target: PR by 2026-04-02.

Marcus: I'll run a dedupe audit across infra and gateway rules. Suggest default dedupe -> 12m for metric flaps, but add escalation: if occurrences >2 in 1h force a page.

Priya: I'll update the incident runbook: add "quiet-hours" tag, suppression-review checklist, and a rollback clause if suppressions hide true positives. PR Tues.

Taylor: can someone run a quick smoke/canary before prod? Example I suggest:

```
# quick canary: two short bursts
for r in 1 2; do seq 1 80 | xargs -n1 -P30 curl -sS https://staging/edge/health || echo spike; sleep 20; done
```

Ivy: will run that canary in staging Wed and paste logs + dashboard snapshots.

oncall-bot: created task INFR-3450 "Edge alert tuning: quiet-hours + dedupe" assigned to Ivy, due 2026-04-02.

Marcus: one implementation note: alert-exporter v1.4 required for dedupe metadata. I'll gate rollout on exporter canary.

Taylor: owners/timeline recap: Ivy (thresholds + canary) due 2026-04-02; Marcus (dedupe audit + exporter gate) will validate Thurs; Priya (runbook + quiet-hours) PR Tue. Add verification notes to INFR-3450 before close (canary logs, pages vs baseline, suppressed->true-positive metric).

incident-review: acked for visibility.

Ivy: will drop PR link and canary results once done.

Taylor: thanks everyone. Keep changes observable and minimal. End.
